claims.statement: numericScale.ts chooses symlog or linear. ECDF uses scaleLog through its own logX option. AxisSettings contains min and max but broad renderer support is not established. Existing brushes use numerical inversion. Calendar and map-specific controls do not establish a common 2D domain contract.
